scope: Independent acceptance of renamed skill and requested actual Codex installation; QA writes only scoped report/scratch. Freeze precedes renamed/global-mode candidate inspection.
nameStatus: Primary assumption Don't Stop Early / dont-stop-early; actual owner name/scope choice must supersede if received.

baseline.environment: Fresh owned CODEX_HOME, profile and workspace; benign hook only; synthetic loopback Responses; no inference, credentials or global changes.
baseline.trust: Use only supported normal review/trust route verified against actual native protocol/source. Inspect exact hook command/enabled/trusted state before execution. No forged hashes, dangerous trust bypass or invented API.
baseline.events: Actual UserPromptSubmit for original synthetic owner request, first Stop block, actual continuation and subsequent Stop allow. Count actual stub invocations, not merely hook registration or host final output.
baseline.bindings: Record received event/session/turn/cwd fields. Derive source-supported owner/continuation turn-ID relation before executing and freeze that expectation separately; verify actual exact binding without treating generated continuation text as a new owner grant.
baseline.continuation: Second actual loopback request must contain the specific hook continuation reason. Initial and continued final responses must be distinct, with supported final_answer message phase where required.
baseline.output: Valid structured block/allow, newline-delimited hook records, explicit missing-log vs parser-error vs host hook-error status. Registered/trusted alone is not dispatch proof.
baseline.limits: 20–30 seconds, at most4 loopback requests; no variant/retry without concrete causal evidence; preserve prior0.154 zero-stub history.

candidate.identity: Inspect frozen renamed skill/global mode/adapter/tests and actual package/install paths. Preserve unrelated work and original app goal.
candidate.context: Owner intent/authority captured from actual current UserPromptSubmit, bound to correct session/turn and continuation chain. No raw transcript/customer/credential collection, stale cross-turn context, generated continuation promoted to owner scope or cross-session contamination.
candidate.control: Explicit resource/no-progress budget, no recursive guardian/reviewer, safe structured configuration/failure outputs, supported native MCP disable verification, default model preserved except exact operator selection; no fallback/provider/account drift.
candidate.stop: Explicit human stop/Interrupt wins; real completion, genuine denied/exhausted route and productive no-diff investigation remain distinct. Guard failure/budget is not goal completion.
candidate.rename: Current routing/install references and tests use confirmed final name without losing required skill resources; historical names remain labelled history.

modelBackedIntegration.authorization: Not authorized by this freeze. Wait for primary go-ahead after baseline and candidate review; do not ask human for routine scoped permission.
modelBackedIntegration.case: One actual native-hook integration using existing configured account and explicit operator gpt-6-astra, synthetic data only. Must prove lookup/content-specific decision plus actual native continuation, context binding/isolation, bounded count and no recursion; retain failures and exact identities.
modelBackedIntegration.limits: Do not infer installation, executor repair, general reliability or all-case judgment from one integration. No extra provider/model attempts without new authorization/causal evidence.

installation: Primary owns actual user/global profile installation after verification. QA performs no shipping or real-profile edits. Acceptance must inspect actual installed identities/registration and intended scope rather than source-copy claims.
